name: Exire
source:
A game where you get to date this cute stickman, by the name of Liam.

Keep in mind that he's very shy and sensitive, and would appreciate if you try and be as nice to him as possible. He gets embaressed really easily.

Liam will appreciate you regardless of your gender. His whole purpose is to make you feel loved and special. 

[Edited from [url=https://intstories.itch.io/exire]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一款可以和可爱火柴人Liam约会的游戏。

要记得他很害羞、敏感，希望你尽可能温柔地对待他。他很容易害羞。

无论你的性别如何，Liam都会珍惜你。他唯一的心愿，就是让你感受到爱与特别。

[译自并改编自[url=https://intstories.itch.io/exire]Itch.io[/url]]
